props.name: header
props.comment: Top of the sidebar; given whether it's collapsed, to show a compact mark in the rail.

props.name: topbar
props.comment: A bar above the page on every screen size; the collapse button moves into it.

props.name: crumbs
props.comment: Where the page sits, shown in the top bar; the last one is the current page.

props.name: inset
props.comment: The page sits in a rounded panel inset from the window; the sidebar shares the window's tint.

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the group ("Chart metric").

props.name: value
props.comment: The chosen metric; the chart below shows it.

props.name: steps
props.type: { label: string; description?: string; error?: string }[]
props.comment: error: something to fix on that step, shown in place of its description.

props.name: current
props.comment: Index of the step in progress; steps before it are done.

props.name: onstep
props.comment: Called when a finished step is chosen, to go back to it. Without it, steps can't be chosen.

props.name: orientation
props.comment: vertical: markers down the side with names beside them, for sidebars and narrow columns.

props.name: value
props.comment: Selected tab. Left unset, the first enabled tab is selected.

props.name: activation
props.comment: automatic: arrow keys select. manual: arrow keys move focus, Enter/Space select.

props.name: variant
props.comment: line: an underline slides to the chosen tab. folder: the chosen tab rises out of the panel like a folder tab. pill: the chosen tab lifts out of a quiet track. folder and pill are horizontal only.

props.name: fit
props.comment:
Size the area to the chosen panel instead of the tallest one, for panels whose lengths
differ a lot (the same code in several languages). What's below moves when tabs switch.

props.name: label
props.comment: Title above the links, and the navigation's name.

props.name: offset
props.comment: Height of anything fixed over the top of the page (a sticky header), in px.

props.name: current
props.comment: id of the section being read; follows the scroll.

props.name: item
props.type: Snippet<[{ item: TreeItem; level: number; expanded: boolean; selected: boolean }]>

props.name: icon
props.type: Snippet<[{ item: TreeItem; expanded: boolean; isFolder: boolean }]>

props.name: href
props.comment: Renders an anchor when provided

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the tree for screen readers.

props.name: expanded
props.comment: Ids of open folders.

props.name: selected
props.comment: Id of the chosen item.

props.name: load
props.comment: Fetches a folder's contents the first time it opens (its `children` start empty).

props.name: searchLabel
props.comment: Shows a search box over the tree with this label; matches anywhere in it are shown.

props.name: query
props.comment: The search, if you'd rather drive it yourself.

props.name: height
props.comment: Height of the scrolling area: any CSS length. Only the rows in it are drawn.

props.name: count
props.comment: How many items it holds, shown under the name.

props.name: color
props.comment: Any CSS color: the accent by default.

props.name: open
props.comment: Held open: while something is dragged over it, say. It also opens on hover and focus.

props.name: selected
props.comment: Selected, in a list where folders can be chosen.

props.name: persist
props.comment: Remember the layout in this browser under this key.

props.name: children
props.comment: Resizable.Panel, with a Resizable.Handle between each pair.

props.name: label
props.comment: What it resizes, for screen readers ("Resize the catalog").

props.name: defaultSize
props.comment: Starting size in percent of the group.

props.name: minSize
props.comment: Smallest it can be dragged to, in percent.

props.name: collapsible
props.comment: Can be dragged (or Entered) shut, and opened again.

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the panel; the handle beside it says what it resizes.

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the scrolling region: keyboard users focus it to scroll.

props.name: maxHeight
props.comment: Tallest it grows before scrolling ("20rem").

props.name: children
props.comment: Text in the middle of the line ("or").

props.name: key
props.comment: A stable id for each item.

props.name: itemLabel
props.comment: Names an item in announcements and on its handle ("Canon of Medicine").

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the list ("Reading list").

props.name: layout
props.comment: list: one column. row: one line. grid: wraps; set its columns with --sortable-columns.

props.name: onreorder
props.comment: Called after a move is dropped, with the new order.

props.name: children
props.type: Snippet<[T, HandleProps, { dragging: boolean; index: number }]>

props.name: label
props.comment: Accessible name; pressed means the dark theme is on.

props.name: key
props.comment: A stable id for each item, so rows keep their measured height when the list changes.
props.default: ((item: any, i: number) => item?.id ?? item?.key ?? i) as any

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the list ("Catalog").

props.name: estimate
props.comment: A guess at a row's height in px; real heights are measured as rows appear.

props.name: gap
props.comment: Space between rows, in px.

props.name: height
props.comment: Height of the scrolling box: any CSS length.

props.name: onend
props.comment: Called when the last rows come into view: load the next page here.

props.name: footer
props.comment: After the rows: a loading line, or "that's everything".

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the widget for screen readers ("Study timer").

props.name: tone
props.comment: Its color: text, lit parts and tinted buttons; plain text color by default.

props.name: max
props.comment: The widest it grows ("36rem"); it fills the space it's given up to this.

props.name: description
props.comment: Short muted text beside the title: a count, a status ("8 rules · 7 on").

props.name: aside
props.comment: Controls at the end of the row, outside the toggle: a switch, a badge, a menu.

props.name: open
props.comment: Controlled or initial open state when used standalone.

props.name: artwork
props.comment: Cover image URL; shown beside the title and on the lock screen.

props.name: visualizer
props.comment: Draws the sound above the timeline. The file's host must allow cross-origin requests.

props.name: element
props.comment: The <audio> element, for your own controls or a Visualizer elsewhere.

props.name: locale
props.comment: Locale for times and speeds; fixed so server and browser render the same text.

props.name: draw
props.type: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, size: { width: number; height: number; dpr: number }) => void
props.comment: One-shot or resize 2D render callback with DPR scaling applied automatically.

props.name: animate
props.type: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, size: { width: number; height: number; dpr: number }, elapsed: number) => void
props.comment: Continuous animation frame callback; receives elapsed time in milliseconds.

props.name: ratio
props.comment: Aspect ratio string, e.g. '16 / 9' or '2 / 1'.

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the carousel ("Treasures of the House of Wisdom").

props.name: perView
props.comment: Slides in view at once.

props.name: autoplay
props.comment: ms between slides when playing on its own; off by default.

props.name: current
props.comment: The first slide in view, to follow along (bind:current). To move it, call go(i) via bind:this.

props.name: messages
props.comment: The conversation, oldest first. Bind it: sending, editing and reacting update it.

props.name: users
props.comment: Everyone in the conversation, you included.

props.name: me
props.comment: Your user id.

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the conversation for screen readers.

props.name: variant
props.comment: bubbles: yours on the far side (Messenger). flat: everyone on one side (Slack).

props.name: typing
props.comment: Ids of who's typing right now.

props.name: unread
props.comment: The first message you haven't read: a "New" divider goes above it, and the view opens there.

props.name: send
props.comment: Delivers a new (or retried) message. Resolve with changes (a server id, a status); throw if it failed.

props.name: save
props.comment: Saves an edit, delete or reaction, already shown. Throw to undo it.

props.name: older
props.comment: Older messages, oldest first, before the ones loaded. An empty list means you've reached the start.

props.name: thread
props.comment: Offers "Reply in thread" and a replies link; called with the message to open.

props.name: menu
props.comment: More items for each message's menu, after Reply in thread and Copy.

props.name: hide
props.comment: Offers "Delete for me" on anyone's message: called once it's hidden. Throw to bring it back.

props.name: focus
props.comment: Scrolls to this message and highlights it (a search result, a pinned message).

props.name: onread
props.comment: Called with the newest message's id once you've seen it.

props.name: draft
props.comment: Keeps unsent text under this key while the chat is closed (one per conversation).

props.name: header
props.comment: Above the messages: a title, members, actions.

props.name: empty
props.comment: Shown while there are no messages yet.

props.name: level
props.comment: Heading level, to fit the page's outline.

props.name: children
props.comment: What happened and what to do about it.

props.name: actions
props.comment: Buttons or links: the way out.

props.name: gridSize
props.comment: Grid pitch in canvas px at zoom 1

props.name: root
props.comment: The map: one central topic and its branches. Bindable; edits replace it with a new tree.

props.name: label
props.comment: Names the map for screen readers ("Plan for the reading room").

props.name: editable
props.comment: Add, rename, move and remove topics. Collapsing works either way.

props.name: sides
props.comment: Branches on both sides of the center, or all to the right (for outlines).

props.name: onchange
props.comment: Called with the new tree after every change.

props.name: title
props.comment: Names the player, and shows on the lock screen and in system media controls.

props.name: artwork
props.comment: Image for the lock screen / media controls (defaults to the poster).

props.name: aspectRatio
props.comment: Width / height, e.g. "16 / 9".

props.name: element
props.comment: The <video> element, for libraries that attach to it (Shaka, hls.js).

props.name: error
props.comment: Set to show your own message over the player (a stream that failed to load).

props.name: children
props.comment: <source> and <track> elements.

props.name: controls
props.comment: Extra controls, placed before fullscreen (a quality menu).

props.name: label
props.comment: Names it for screen readers ("Voice message from Maryam").

props.name: peaks
props.comment: Normalized peak values (0 to 1).

props.name: progress
props.comment: Scrub / playhead progress percentage (0 to 100).

props.name: duration
props.comment: Total duration in seconds (optional, for time readouts).

props.name: filename
props.comment: Shown above the code ("src/routes/+page.svelte"), and names it for screen readers.

props.name: highlight
props.comment: Lines to draw attention to: "3", "3-5", "3-5, 9".

props.name: level
props.comment: Heading tag level (h1 through h6). Defaults to 2.

props.name: size
props.comment: Visual size scale 1-6. When omitted, matches the level.

props.name: as
props.comment: HTML tag to render. Defaults to 'p'.

props.name: tone
props.comment: Semantic text tone color.

props.name: mono
props.comment: Monospace code font family.

props.name: truncate
props.comment: Single-line text truncation with ellipsis.
